title: Homework set: quadratic graphs and turning points
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 65 (Complete the portal's quadratic graphs set (6 questions) and update your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions about y = x² − 2x − 15 and other quadratics. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: Find the roots of y = x² − 2x − 15.
Write down the y-intercept of y = x² − 2x − 15.
Find the turning point of y = x² − 2x − 15 by completing the square.
Write x² + 6x + 2 in the form (x + a)² + b and give the turning point of y = x² + 6x + 2.
Write down the equation of the line of symmetry of y = x² − 8x + 3.
Show that 3x² − 6x + 7 = 0 has no real roots.
questions.a: 3(x − 1)² + 4 (M1 A1); the minimum value is 4 > 0, so the graph never meets the x-axis (A1). (Or b² − 4ac = 36 − 84 = −48 < 0.)
